_about: Drawn 3D board for site/boardviz (tools/boardviz/README.md). Millimeters from the board's bottom-left corner, x right, y up, rot in degrees counterclockwise. parts: the hand-placed parts, each with a type the part library knows; a part with an id can carry a label and text shown when tapped. headers: cols x rows at 2.54 mm, pins named top row first, left column first; pins with names become tap targets. decor: two-pad parts found by tools/boardviz/pads_from_drawing.py, drawn but never labelled.
source: Positions first read from the board drawings in the kit's user guide (SLAU928B): figure 4-7 PCB top layer and figure 4-8 PCB top overlay, scale from the 2.54 mm BoosterPack pin pitch, figure 2-1 for which part is which, figure 4-2 for the BoosterPack pin names. Checked part by part against a top-down bench photo of the real board (Rev. A, mspm0l2228/img/board-top-rev-a.jpg) on 2026-11-09: part presence, positions, header pin names and which jumpers carry shunts. Positions are mapped from the photo with the four mounting holes as reference; the tops of tall parts (shunts, pins) lean outward in the photo, so tall parts near the left edge (the RGB jumpers) keep the position that the silkscreen footprint gives. The LCD is drawn as a glass block (a screen) sized from the photo, the super capacitor as a can on its housing. J16's LED5 is not fitted on this board. No two-pad decor: the drawings carry no gold pads for tools/boardviz/pads_from_drawing.py.

parts.label: USB
parts.title: Micro-USB
parts.text: One cable powers the board, programs it and carries its text output through the debug probe.

parts.label: Debug probe
parts.title: XDS110 debug probe
parts.text: The top half of the board is the debugger, an MSP432E401Y. It flashes the chip over SWD, gives the computer a serial port and measures power with EnergyTrace.

parts.label: The chip
parts.title: MSPM0L2228
parts.text: A Cortex-M0+ in an 80-pin LQFP, 14 mm across the leads. It drives the 7-segment LCD, has a 32 kHz and a battery-backed low-frequency subsystem, and brings its pins out to the BoosterPack headers.

parts.label: Reset
parts.title: S3, reset
parts.text: Restarts the program from the top. Marked MSP NRST.

parts.label: Button 1
parts.title: S1 on PA18
parts.text: A user button on PA18, which is also the bootloader pin. Jumper J19 connects it.

parts.label: Button 2
parts.title: S2 on PB8
parts.text: The second user button, on PB8. Jumper J20 connects it.

parts.name: LED1
parts.label: Probe LEDs
parts.title: LED1 and LED2
parts.text: Two status lights for the debug probe: LED1 is red and LED2 is green.

parts.name: LED3
parts.label: Red LED
parts.title: LED3, red
parts.text: A red LED from 3V3 through 470 ohms to PA0. Jumper J9 connects it.

parts.name: LED4
parts.label: RGB LED
parts.title: LED4, RGB
parts.text: Blue on PA16, red on PB10, green on PB9, each through its own resistor. Jumpers J10, J11 and J12 connect them.

parts.label: Isolation jumpers
parts.title: J101 isolation block
parts.text: Jumpers join the debug probe to the chip: ground, 5V, 3V3, RXD, TXD, reset, SWDIO, SWCLK, the bootloader pin and VBAT. Pull one to cut that line.

parts.label: CAP pin
parts.title: CAP and the VBAT select
parts.text: The single pin under the last column of J101. A jumper from VBAT to CAP lets the super capacitor feed the chip's battery pin.

parts.label: S1 jumper
parts.title: J19
parts.text: Connects button S1 to PA18. Pull it to free PA18 for something else.

parts.label: S2 jumper
parts.title: J20
parts.text: Connects button S2 to PB8. Pull it to free PB8 for something else.

parts.label: UART jumpers
parts.title: J17 and J18
parts.text: Top and center (as shipped): PA11 and PA10 go to the debug probe, so the computer sees the chip's text. Move the jumper down and they go to the BoosterPack pins instead.

parts.label: TamperIO jumpers
parts.title: J13, J14 and J15
parts.text: Center and bottom (as shipped): PB3, PB2 and PA7 connect the BoosterPack pin to the TamperIO. Move one up to free the pin.

parts.label: LED5 jumper
parts.title: J16, LED5 (not fitted)
parts.text: A spare red LED to ground through 470 ohms is not fitted. A wire on this pin would drive it.

parts.label: Red LED jumper
parts.title: J9
parts.text: Connects the red LED to PA0. Pull it to free PA0 for I2C.

parts.label: I2C pull-ups
parts.title: J7 and J8
parts.text: Pull-ups for PA0 and PA1 (I2C). Shunts on the right and center pins, as shipped: 4.7k to 5V. Left and center: 2.2k to 3V3.

parts.label: RGB jumpers
parts.title: J10, J11 and J12
parts.text: Connect the blue, red and green channels of the RGB LED (J10, J11, J12). Pull one to free its pin.

parts.label: 3V3 power
parts.title: J6, 3V3 power header
parts.text: Ground, ground and 3V3. Feed the board from here, or take power off it.

parts.label: 5V power
parts.title: J5, 5V power header
parts.text: Ground, ground and 5V. Feed the board from here, or take power off it.

parts.label: Probe out
parts.title: J102, XDS110 out
parts.text: A 10-pin debug header that lets the on-board probe program a different board.

parts.label: Probe in
parts.title: J103, XDS110 in
parts.text: A 10-pin header for using an outside probe in place of the on-board one.

parts.label: 32.768 kHz
parts.title: Y1, 32.768 kHz crystal
parts.text: The low-frequency crystal (LFXT) for the clock and the low-power counter.

parts.label: 32 MHz
parts.title: Y2, 32 MHz crystal
parts.text: The high-frequency crystal (HFXT). The chip runs from its own 32 MHz oscillator by default.

parts.label: Super capacitor
parts.title: 100 mF super capacitor
parts.text: Holds the battery pin up when USB is off. A jumper from VBAT to CAP on J101 connects it.

parts.label: 7-segment LCD
parts.title: LCD
parts.text: An on-board 7-segment display driven by the chip's own LCD controller, with a charge pump or resistor ladder.

parts.label: BoosterPack J1, J3
parts.title: Left BoosterPack headers
parts.text: J1 is the outer column, pins 1 to 10 from the top. J3 is the inner column, pins 21 to 30. Plug-on boards stack on these.

parts.label: BoosterPack J4, J2
parts.title: Right BoosterPack headers
parts.text: J4 is the inner column, pins 40 to 31 from the top. J2 is the outer column, pins 20 to 11.
